name: Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu
location: Burnside Corridor — transit hub connecting Shelf to Circuit, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 31, there's something unfinished about his face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone — and he makes no effort to hide it.

His entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. He works as a sniper out of Burnside Corridor, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

he is not the most talented sniper in GLMZ, but he might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Eshe Zhukov-Wiredu represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone. Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — the build of someone who maintains fitness out of necessity rather than vanity. Long-limbed, minimal body fat, shoulders slightly narrower than hips. There's a coiled tension to his frame, like a spring compressed.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, practical cut — no styling product, maintained for function. Slight curl at the temples.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with golden undertones — the blend of his Russian and Wiredu lineage evident in his complexion
physical_description.complexion: Angular, high cheekbones, a narrow jaw that tapers sharply. His face is striking but unrefined — skin shows minor scarring along the left temple (old wound, poorly healed), slight darkness under the eyes from chronic sleep deficit. Facial hair is kept minimal, usually a day or two of stubble rather than fully shaved or grown.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple toward the hairline, approximately 3cm, partially obscured by hair growth
Faint chemical burn scars on the right side of his neck (approximately 2cm x 1cm) — pale pink, slightly raised, from a volatile extraction gone wrong
Small tattoo on inner left wrist: a simple crosshair symbol in black ink, barely 1cm diameter
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome nasal passages — visible as faint metallic shimmer around his nostrils and the bridge of his nose where the chemical analyzer integrates with natural tissue. The chrome catches light and creates an uncanny reflection. No other visible augmentations, though the pain editor is subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: He moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. His posture is slightly forward-leaning, as if perpetually tracking something. His head tracks slowly, methodically, eyes registering details. When he sits, he positions himself with clear sight lines to exits. There's a stillness to him when focused, an absence of fidgeting or nervous energy. When not focused, he exhibits minor tremors in his hands — either from stimulant use or the edge that chronic pain-dampening creates.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 pragmatist. Dark colors — charcoal, black, deep gray. Worn tactical cargo pants with multiple pockets and reinforced seams, synthetic blend that sheds dirt and dries fast. Layered tops: usually a dark long-sleeve compression shirt under a heavier jacket (synthetic leather or ballistic nylon, no visible branding). Boots are military-grade, scuffed, laces double-knotted. A worn canvas messenger bag (faded black, multiple repair patches) carries his essentials. No jewelry except a faded paracord bracelet on his left wrist. His jacket has several deep pockets and one internal pocket where he keeps dead-drop messages. Everything is functional, nothing is fashionable.
